name: Kalashtar
description: People joined to dream spirits, possessing disciplined and telepathic minds.

grants.name: Dual Mind
grants.description: You have Advantage on Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

grants.name: Mental Discipline
grants.description: You have Resistance to Psychic damage.

grants.name: Mind Link
grants.description: You have telepathy out to 10 times your character level in feet and can temporarily enable a contacted creature to reply.

grants.name: Severed from Dreams
grants.description: Dream cannot target you. After each Long Rest, choose one skill proficiency that lasts until your next Long Rest.
